paite: Huai thilte i lak ua tak petpet a gintak a om, mi tampi in athu gelh ana tup uh,
heading: Laibu In Atup / (Nas 1.1)

paite: atung a pan a mute leh thu nasemte'n ahon hilh bang un,
Theophilus aw, abul a pan bangkim chiantak in ka sui a, kizom zel in nang a ding in kigelhleh ahoih ding, ka chi hi;
huai tuma a nang ahon hilh uh thudik ahi chih na theihsemna ding in.
Judia gam kumpipa Herod adam lai in, Abijah pawl a mi amin Zakariah a-om a; huai mi in Aaron tanute lak a khat zi in anei a, amin Elizabeth ahi.
heading: Baptispa Johan Pian Ding Thu

paite: Anih un Pathian mitmuh in diktat in a-om ua, gensiatbei in Toupa thupiak leh adan thuseh tengteng zui in a-om zel uhi.
Himahleh Elizabeth achiin ziak in ta anei kei ua, anih un upa pitak ahi tuak uhi.
Huan hichibang ahi a, apawlte hihdan ngeina bang a Pathian ma a siampu nna sem a a-om lai in,
siampu dan bang in Toupa tempul a lut leh gimlim hal atan ahi.
Gimlim hal hun lai in mipite avek un inpua ah ana thum uhi.
Toupa angel khat gimlim halna maitam taklam a dingh in akiang ah akilak hi.
Zakariah in amuhtak in alungzing a, lauh leng alau hi.
Himahleh angel in akiang ah, "Zakariah, lau ke'n, na ngetna zak a a-om ziak in, na zi Elizabeth in tapa hon neihsak dia, amin Johan na sak ding ahi.
Huan nang nuam in na kipak ding a; amah apian in mi tampi akipak ding uhi.
Toupa ngaih in milian ahi dia, uain leh zu himhim adawn kei ding; anu sung a pan in Kha Siangthou in adim ding hi.
Israel suante tampi Toupa a Pathian lam uh angasak nawn ding hi.

Pate lungtang tate lam angasak ding, michihmohte midiktat pilna lam ngasak ding, Toupa a dia mipite mansa a omsak ding a bawlkhol ding in Elijah lungsim leh thilhihtheihna pu in Toupa ma ah apai ding," achi hi.
Huan Zakariah in angel kiang ah, "Huai bangchi in ka thei dia? Kei putekpi hi ing a, ka zi leng pitek ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Angel in adawng a, akiang ah, "Kei Gabriel, Pathian ma a dingh zel ka hi; nang hon houpih ding leh hiai thuhoih hon hilh ding a sawl ka hi.
Ngai in ka thugente ahuntak a hong tung ding, na gintak louh ziak in huai thilte ahong tun masiah na dai dide ding a, pau leng na pau thei kei ding," achi hi.
Huan mipite'n Zakariah ana ngak ua, tempul sung a a-om sawt ziak in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Huan ahong pawt in akiang uah thu agen theita kei hi; huchi in tempul ah kha kilak amu ahi chih atheita ua; akiang uah chiamtehnate abawl a, pau thei lou in a-om hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, anasepna ni akimtak in a-inn ah apaita hi.
Huai nite nung in, azi Elizabeth agaita a, kha nga akisel zoh in,
"Mi lak a ka minse khuhna ding in, Toupa'n ahon muh in, hichibang in ka tung ah ahihta," achi hi.
Huan akha gukna ah Pathian in Galili gam a khua khat Nazaret achih uah, angel Gabriel,
heading: Jesu Pian Ding Thu

paite: nungak siangthou khat kiang ah asawl a, huai nungak tuh David suan a mi khat amin Joseph toh kikham ahi ua; nungak min Mari ahi.
Huan akiang ah angel alut a, "Chibai, nang nakpitak a deihtuam; na kiang ah Toupa a-om," achi hi.
Huai thugen ziak in alunghimoh mahmah a, bangchidan a chibai hon buk adiam aw? chi in akingaihtuah hi.
Angel in akiang ah, "Mari, lau ke'n; Pathian a pan deihsakna na tang hi.
Ngai in, na gai ding a, tapa na nei dia, amin Jesu na sa ding hi.
Amah milian ahong hi ding a, Tungnungpen Tapa achi ding uh. Toupa Pathian in apu David laltutphah ape dia,
Jakob suante tung ah tangtawn in vai ahawm dia, agam in bei ni anei kei ding,” achi hi.
Huan Mari in angel kiang ah, "Hiai bangchi in ahi thei dia? Pasal lah nei lou ing a," achi hi.

Huan angel in adawng a, akiang ah, "Na tung ah Kha Siangthou ahong tung ding a, Tungnungpen thilhihtheihna in ahon liahkhum ding, huaiziak in misiangthou hong piang ding leng, siangthou Pathian Tapa chih in a-om ding, achi hi.
Ngai in, na sanggamnu Elizabeth in leng atek nung in tapa apaita; achiing achih uh, tu kha akha gukna ahita hi.
Pathian thupawt himhim thil hi thei lou a-om kei," achi hi.
Mari in, "Ngai in, Toupa sikhanu ka hi, na thu bang zel in ka tung ah tung hen," achi hi. Huan angel in apaisanta hi.
Huai lai in Mari athou a, singtang ah, Judia gam a khua khat ah ahoh pah hi.
heading: Mari In Elizabeth Avehna

paite: Zakariah inn ah alut a, Elizabeth chibai abuk hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mari in Elizabeth chibai abuktak in, asung a naungek ahong kitawm a; Kha Siangthou in Elizabeth ahong dimta hi; aw ngaihtak in akikou a,
"Nang numei sapsap ding in na hampha hi, na gilgah leng ahampha hi.
Ka Toupa nu ka kiang a na hong bangchidan ahia oi?
Ngai in, na hon chibai buk husa ka bil a aluttak in, akipah ziak in ka sung a naungek akitawm hi.
Agingtanu leng ahampha hi, akiang a Toupa thugen tangtung ding ahih ziak in," achi hi.
Huan Mari in: "Ka nuntakna in Toupa apahtawi e,
heading: Mari Phatna La

paite: ka kha leng ka Hondampa Pathian tung ah akipak mahmah a.
Asikhanu namtomdan amu a, ahehpih a; ngai in, tunung siah khang tengteng in hampha ahon chi ding uh.
Amah mihat in ka tung ah thil thupitak ahon hihsak a, amin leng asiangthou hi.
Amah laute tung ah akhang- akhang in azahngaihna a-om hi.
Aban in athahatdan a-ensak a, mikisatheite alunggelna uh ahihdalhta hi.
Alaltutphah ua tu kumpipate akaikhia a, namtomte apahtawita hi.
Gilkialte thil hoih in ahihvah a, mihaute khutvuak in apaimangsakta hi.
Asikha Israel taksap awng ahuta a, azahngaihna theihgigena ding in.
I pipute Abraham leh asuante kiang a tangtawn thuchiam agen bang ahi."
Akiang uah kha thum vel Mari a-om a, a-inn ah akik nawnta hi.
Huan Elizabeth nau neih ahong hunta a; huchi in tapa ahon neita hi.
heading: Baptispa Johan Pianna

paite: Toupa'n atung ah azahngaihna thupi asuah chih avengte leh asanggamte'n ana za ua, akipahpih uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani giat ni in naungek zeksum ding in ahong pai ua; amin ding in apa min mah Zakariah sak atum uhi.
Anu'n, "Hilou e, Johan chih ding ahi," chi in adawng hi.
Anu kiang ah, "Na sanggamte lak ah hiai min pu kuamah a-om kei uh, achi uhi.
Huan apa kiang ah chiamtehna bawl in, amin ding in bang sa lehang na deih a? achi uhi.
Huan laigelhna pek angen a, amin Johan ahi," chi in agelh hi.
Avek un lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Thakhat in akam hong kihong in, alei ahong kiphel a, Pathian phat in ahong paukheta hi.
Akim ua omte tengteng in alauta ua; huchi in huai thute Judia gam singtang gam tengteng ah athangta hi.
Aza peuhmah in, alungtang un avei chiat ua, "Huai naungek bangchi phet ahong hi diam aw?" achi uhi. Huan Toupa khut in amah apanpih hi.
Huan apa Zakariah, Kha Siangthou in adim a, agenkhol a,
heading: Zakariah Thugenkholhna

paite: "Toupa Israel' Pathian phat in om hen, amite ahong veh a, tatna abawlsak hi.
Asikha David inkuante lak ah hotdamna kii ahon bawlsak tak ziak in;
Tang lai a pan a zawlnei siangthoute kam a agen bang in.
I doute lak leh hon ho tengteng lak a hotdam a i om ding thu,
I pipute kiang a achiam zahngaihna tangtungsak ding leh athukhun siangthou theigige ding in.
I pu Abraham kiang a kichiam a,
I doute lak a ahon humbit a, lau lou a ama nna i sepna ding in.
I damsung teng a amitmuh a siangthou leh diktattak a omna ding in.
Ahi, Bawi, nang zaw Tungnungpen Zawlnei ahon chi ding ua; alampite bawlkhol ding in Toupa ma ah na pai ding hi.
Akhelhnate uh ngaihdamna dia amite kiang a hotdamna theihna pe ding in.
I Pathian lungtang a zahngaihna nou ngiingei ziak in, huchi in tunglam a kipan i tung a ninou suak in ahong veh ding a,
mial lak leh sihna lim a tute tanvak ding leh khamuanna lampi a i khete kalsuansak ding in," achi hi.
Huan naungek ahong khanglian deuhdeuh a, akhalam ahong hat hiaihiai a, Israelte kiang a ahong kilak masiah gamdai ah a-om gige hi.
